title: Avoca’s public works case ended in two felony pleas and a $500,000 restitution order

beats.text: Two contractor licenses lead back to one public works business.

beats.text: One was issued to a sole owner in 1995.

beats.text: Each records a revocation on March 9, 2009.

visual.kicker: The same administrative complaint appears on each license

beats.text: The corporate license had already expired.
The City task force separately traced the criminal case.
